bugClass.title: Journal data reaches user-facing reads without review
bugClass.cause: Data written to a shared journal or event log can be read or forwarded to a user-facing surface by any actor because the read and notification paths have no review or approval gate.
bugClass.criteria: A site exhibits this cause when journaled flags, blockers, or similar entries become visible in user-facing reads or notifications without an intervening review decision. This qualifies whether the missing gate is in the write path, the read path, or the notification path.

candidates.evidence: Lines 19–24 show the GET path reading `revision` and `flaggedAt` and returning the stored item and recent runs. This could expose a flagged journal item through an inbox read, but the excerpt does not show whether `readInboxItem` or `items.getStored` applies a review gate or what content is returned.
